local p = {}
local data = mw.loadData('Module:Enemy/data')
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local yesno = require('Module:Yesno')
function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame)
	return p._main(args)
end
function p._main(args)
	local key = args[1]
	if not key then return '' end
	local enemy = data[key]
	if not enemy then return '<i>Enemy "<code>'..key..'</code>" not found in database</i>' end
	local gridview = yesno(args.g or args.gv or args.gridview)
	local node = p._enemy_data{
		name=enemy.name,
		code=enemy.code,
		type=enemy.type,
		link=enemy.enemy,
		class=enemy.class,
		image=enemy.image,
		qty=args[2],
		qty2=args[3],
		gridview=gridview,
		nolink=args.nolink,
		mode=args.mode or 'normal',
	}
	if gridview then
		local div = mw.html.create('div')
		:attr('style', 'display:inline-block; position:relative; margin:5px;')
		:node(node)
		return div
	else
		return node
	end
end
function p._enemy_data(args)
	local pagename = args.name or args[1]
	local link = args.link or pagename
	local text = args.title or pagename
	local mode = args.mode or 'normal'
	local image = args.image or (args.name .. ' sprite.png')
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = args.name,
		['data-title'] = args.title,
		['data-code'] = args.code,
		['data-race'] = args.type,
		['data-type'] = args.class,
		['data-link'] = args.link,
	}
	local qty
	if args.qty then
		if not args.qty2 then
			qty = args.qty
		elseif mode == 'mc' then
			qty = (args.qty + args.qty2)..' ('..args.qty..'/'..args.qty2..')'
		elseif mode == 'normal' then
			qty = args.qty..' ~ '..args.qty2
		end
	end
	local root = mw.html.create('')
	if args.gridview then
		local a = root:tag('div')
			:addClass('a')
		local tooltip = a:tag('div')
			:addClass('enemy-tooltip')
			:attr(attrs)
			:wikitext('[[File:'..image..'|60x60px|link='..link..( text and '|'..text or '' )..']]')
		if qty then
			a:tag('div')
				:attr('style', "text-align:center; margin-top:2px;")
				:wikitext('×'..qty)
		end
	else
		local tooltip = root:tag('span')
			:addClass('enemy-tooltip')
			:attr(attrs)
			:wikitext(yesno(args.nolink) and text or '[['..link..'|'..text..']]')
		if qty then
			root:wikitext(' ×'..qty)
		end
	end
	return root
end
return p
